method: Trig identity simplification; option C read as the product (likely misprint)
steps: divided by sec*cosec gives sec2A*cosec2A (= tan2A+cot2A)
No option equals this literally; option C 'sec 2A + cosec 2A' is taken as the misprinted product sec 2A . cosec 2A
check_code:
import sympy as sp
x=sp.symbols('x')  # x = 2A
sec=1/sp.cos(x); csc=1/sp.sin(x)
e=(2+sp.tan(x)**2+sp.cot(x)**2)/(sec*csc)
target=sec*csc  # computed simplified form
pts=[0.2,0.5,0.9]
same=lambda f,g: all(abs(float((f-g).subs(x,p)))<1e-12 for p in pts)
assert same(e,target)
# Option C interpreted as sec2A . cosec2A (the '+' treated as misprint of the product dot)
opts={'A':sec-csc,'B':sp.cot(x)-csc,'C':sec*csc,'D':sec+sp.tan(x)}
assert same(e,opts['C'])
for k in 'ABD': assert not same(e,opts[k])
